capabilities.description: Creates and tracks interim payment certificates and progress claims, linking claim lines to BOQ items and quantities from document:harbourline_boq.xlsx, applies the 5% retention under Clause 14.3 of document:harbourline_contract.pdf, and routes claims through approval.

Tracks elapsed days against the 730-day Time for Completion in Clause 8.2 of document:harbourline_contract.pdf, computes delay damages at 0.1% per day capped at 10% of the Accepted Contract Amount under Clause 8.7, and raises alerts when the cap or milestones are approached.
Captures Inspection and Test Plan records, hold points, inspection results, and sign-offs against work items, with evidence attachments and an immutable audit trail.
Maintains a controlled register of project documents with version history, review status, and distribution; ingests the contract and BOQ as source-of-record documents and tracks revisions.

Extracts and governs key contract terms (time for completion, delay damages, retention, performance security, defects notification period) from document:harbourline_contract.pdf, provides a clause register, and checks claims and outputs against these terms.
Provides a project commercial dashboard showing claim status, cumulative certified amounts, retention balances, delay-damages exposure, and QA/ITP open items.

summary: A contracts-administration platform for the Harbourline Civil Works project that treats the uploaded contract and BOQ as the source of record. It manages progress claims against BOQ line items, tracks delay damages under Clause 8.7 with a configurable daily rate and cap, maintains QA/ITP records, and provides a controlled document register. The platform serves the project's contracts and commercial team, QA/QC staff, and document controllers.
